selection: No arm/seed winner selection; all four fresh fits reported

false_signal_protocol.side_true_positive: chosen side is a positive bit of y_crossing; BOTH qualifies either side
false_signal_protocol.wrong_side: y_crossing>0 and chosen side is absent from positive target bits
false_signal_protocol.primary_side_recall_denominator: All known X-admitted positive event roots; common across models
false_signal_protocol.none_false_positive: Selected alert on y_crossing=NONE; geometric false signal, not an execution loss

calibration_none_fpr.cohort: Known feature-available CAL NONE roots only
calibration_none_fpr.selection: Sort CAL NONE scores descending s[0..n-1], k=floor(0.05*n); threshold=np.nextafter(s[k],+inf) in float64
calibration_none_fpr.comparison: float64 score >= frozen float64 threshold; inclusive and conservative under ties
calibration_none_fpr.test_rule: Apply unchanged frozen CAL threshold to TEST; no positive TPR or TEST outcome used for fitting

fixed_test_execution_stress.role: Descriptive TEST stress only; never selects arm, seed, checkpoint, risk or policy
fixed_test_execution_stress.execution: Frozen original execution, costs and risk plans; partial/censored replay remains incomplete

historical_exposure: The same dates, TEST outcomes, fitted predictions and results were previously inspected in scientific_pipeline_v3. The soft capped weighting hypothesis is motivated by V3 findings. This is a controlled follow-up on an exposed TEST block, not a fresh blind holdout. Older cognition experiments also assigned June to training and July to validation.
